properties.name: A shortened reply can cut a node id to "…", so a paged compare_designs list is not readable in full
properties.statement: MEASURED 2026-10-12, OBSERVATION ONLY (no cause claimed; not yet root-caused). Through the --call door, compare_designs between two real flo2 design files (docs/design/flo2.json at flo2 main 0912a84 and at main~25; 120 design.added, 1,240 edges_added). On the 0.83.2 release build: paging design.added with list + offset at budget_chars 4000 returns all 120 items in 6 pages, every page within budget, but one page item came back {"name": "…", "node_id": "…", "node_type": "Capability"}; at budget_chars 8000 six items on one page had node_id "…"; at 30000 none. The paged ids therefore do not match the unshortened list (9 duplicates of "…" across the pages). On the 0.83.1 served binary the plain shortened diff at budget_chars 4000 also carried 10 entries whose id was "…" (fields_trimmed 648), so this is not new in 0.83.2; 0.83.2's plain diff at 4000 carried none. Effect: an id cut to "…" cannot be looked up, which defeats paging's purpose of reading a list in full. Workaround: raise budget_chars until fields_trimmed is absent.
